commands.name: m121_context_aligned_outcome_critical_miner

decision_rule: Proceed toward objective training only if outcome-critical wrong-history rows pass strict response/context matching and source-diversity gates.
failure_criteria: accepted rows require context distance above the strict threshold
accepted rows cover fewer than 6 physical pairs or fewer than 5 source decision steps
accepted rows are only reset or zero-current response effects
M62 control is admitted as an outcome-critical wrong-history surface
hypothesis: M120 finds relaxed outcome-sensitive rows, but they fail strict context matching. Context-aligned snapshot pairing or relocation may preserve the margin-gap signal while satisfying the human-view current-context contract.
success_criteria: strict context threshold remains at or below 0.05
wrong-history outcome degradation is measured on accepted rows
accepted rows pass source-diversity targets before training
the result decides whether M120's relaxed rows can become a clean training surface
